I looked at the second tab and saw the following error:

"Error: attempt to apply non-function"

It looks like, since the app is loading properly, the issue is outside of Shiny Server or anything we control. Maybe you can check to make sure that all the code is the exact version you have on your desktop and check to see if you have all the packages you need in your Spark account.

Good luck!

Jeff
